headline: AI Vulnerability Scan Discovers Flaws Impacting Bitcoin Nodes
summary: An AI language-model scan uncovered three flaws capable of crashing Bitcoin nodes on Windows and Mac systems, publicly disclosed under core bug-reporting rules.
why: Security vulnerabilities affecting core client software infrastructure can introduce operational risks to cryptocurrency networks and node operators.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Discovery of software vulnerabilities highlights potential stability risks, though patches are part of standard protocol maintenance.
